svg.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.text: From every idea to every review, each loop feeds what it learns back in — fast loops inside, slow loops outside.
retrain on full data, test on
an idea → build (L1/L2) or request data (L3)
every result, pass or fail — the agent's memory
fix and retry until it runs, then check and screen
all results re-rank the ideas and sharpen generation
pulled data becomes a new source to build from
findings inspire the analyst's next direction
